assumed.text: Loop inductance assumed 20 nH (a TO-220 on a compact board): give yours
Common-source inductance left out, as with a Kelvin source pin: give yours (about 5 nH for this package without one)
Gate-loop inductance left out: give yours
Gate driver assumed +10 V / 0 V, the usual for a Si MOSFET: give yours
Ringing damped as the losses of a board and its parts usually damp it: it dies within about 8 cycles
Gate resistance on 3.8 Ω, chosen by the tool for the limits: give yours
Gate resistance off 19 Ω, chosen by the tool for the limits: give yours

notes: The turn-on meets the datasheet's energy only with a large correction (7.3 times the gate-drain charge the datasheet gives): its shape is indicative. The loss model does not see the loop inductance, which here changes how the voltage and current cross.

signature.line: Si MOSFET: the body diode's recovery lifts the turn-on current to 73.1 A; turn-off overshoots and rings, with no tail.

name: made-up 100 V MOSFET
